item.title: Reviewing Agent-Generated Code at Scale: Six Verification Layers on the Claude Code Team
item.description: How the Claude Code team—where Claude writes roughly 90% of the code—replaced line-by-line human gatekeeping with six automated verification layers, risk-based approval counts, convergence rules for agent review loops, and fast rollback.

item.title: Six Rules for Keeping Scheduled Morning Agent Briefs from Failing Silently
item.description: Walking through Anthropic’s Claude Managed Agents reference automation for scheduled Slack and GitHub morning briefs, focusing on bookmarks, delivery confirmation, ledgers, read-only preferences, and per-run budget caps.

item.title: Claude Code Cloud Sessions: Running Parallel Tasks Beyond Your Laptop
item.description: How Claude Code cloud sessions isolate each task in its own virtual machine and Git branch, which workloads belong in the cloud versus on your laptop, and how to avoid common GitHub setup pitfalls.
